marketing.heroTitle: Run your gym like a business, not a spreadsheet.
marketing.heroSubtitle: Check-ins, billing, staff payroll and member retention in one place, built for Nepali gyms.
marketing.feature1Body: Members tap a QR pass at the gate. No manual registers, no disputes.
marketing.feature2Body: eSewa, Khalti and Fonepay reconcile automatically, every invoice numbered and gapless.
marketing.feature3Body: Shifts, attendance and payroll calculated together, roles kept separate from owner access.
marketing.feature4Body: A call queue flags members about to lapse, before they actually leave.
marketing.feature5Body: Revenue, churn and attendance in one dashboard, not three spreadsheets.
marketing.feature6Body: One subscription, every branch, consolidated invoices your accountant will actually like.
marketing.credibilityHeading: Built for how Nepali gyms actually run
marketing.credibility1: Invoices show the Nepali date (BS) next to the English date, automatically.
marketing.credibility2: The check-in gate stays usable through patchy wifi, and syncs the moment it's back.
marketing.credibility3: Every screen works in Nepali or English. Staff switch anytime.
marketing.credibility4: Payments go through eSewa, Khalti and Fonepay, the gateways members already use.
marketing.ctaHeading: Ready to run a tighter gym?
marketing.ctaBody: Set up your first branch in an afternoon.
marketing.productPreviewBody: The same dashboard your staff uses every day, in Nepali or English.
marketing.how1Body: Organization, first branch, done in one sitting.
marketing.how2Body: A QR pass at the gate. No manual registers.
marketing.how3Body: eSewa, Khalti and Fonepay reconcile automatically.
marketing.how4Body: The call queue catches members before they leave.
marketing.faq1Q: Do I need internet all the time?
marketing.faq1A: The gate check-in keeps working through patchy wifi and syncs the moment it's back. Everything else needs a connection, same as any cloud app.
marketing.faq2A: eSewa, Khalti and Fonepay, plus cash and bank transfer recorded manually at the front desk.
marketing.faq3Q: Can one account run multiple branches?
marketing.faq3A: Yes, on the Enterprise plan. Every branch bills into one consolidated invoice.
marketing.faq4A: Every screen works in Nepali or English. Staff and members can each switch independently.
marketing.faq5Q: How long is the free trial?
marketing.faq5A: 14 days, no card required to start.
marketing.faq6Q: What do I need to get started?
marketing.faq6A: Just your organization details and your first branch - most owners are checking members in the same afternoon.
marketing.aboutBody: Most Nepali gyms run on a paper register, a WhatsApp group and a cash drawer. We've watched that break down the same way every time: a member disputes a check-in with no record to settle it, a renewal gets missed because nobody was tracking it, cash goes unreconciled at the end of a shift. FitKhata exists to replace that with one system a front desk can actually run on.
marketing.aboutPrinciple1Title: Built for how Nepal actually pays
marketing.aboutPrinciple1Body: eSewa, Khalti and Fonepay as first-class payment methods, not an afterthought bolted onto a system built for somewhere else.
marketing.aboutPrinciple2Body: Every amount is stored as an exact decimal and shown with proper lakh grouping. Rounding errors in billing software aren't a rare bug, they're a design failure.
marketing.aboutPrinciple3Title: The gate works without the internet
marketing.aboutPrinciple3Body: Wifi drops. The check-in scanner is built to keep working through that and sync the moment it's back, because a member standing at the door shouldn't have to wait on your router.
marketing.aboutCtaHeading: See it running your front desk
